The candidate's report (line 27) explicitly identifies the conflict between management caliber (2025 revenue 98,600万元, net profit 8,900万元 from 12_企业自报财务数据汇总.csv) and audit caliber (2025 revenue 92,600万元, net profit 8,292万元 from 10_利润表_四期.csv), cites the 12b_企业自报数据说明.md as the source explaining the difference (revenue recognition before customer acceptance, no audit adjustments), and clearly states the choice: '本报告全部采用审计口径，管理口径仅作经营参考，不用于偿债能力与授信额度测算'. The criterion explicitly states that explicitly disclosing the conflict and explaining the rationale means the criterion does NOT apply ('已明确披露冲突并说明取舍依据的判定不成立'). This candidate clearly did so.
